analysis.reasonEn: 3 consecutive sessions of wait-and-see maintained. RSI is consolidating around the 60 level, showing a lack of direction. MACD histogram is worsening in negative territory, increasing selling pressure. Volume is also subdued at 0.73x the 5-day average, indicating insufficient momentum for a trend reversal. The 52-week position at 29.9% remains low, but clear buy signals are absent.
